primary_source.citation: de Leva P. Adjustments to Zatsiorsky-Seluyanov’s segment inertia parameters. J Biomech. 1996;29(9):1223-1230.
primary_source.population: 100 male and 15 female Caucasian subjects underlying Zatsiorsky parameters; mean ages 24/19. Segment lengths/joint offsets estimated from multiple inputs, not directly remeasured in this paper.
primary_source.measurement_definition: Adjusted longitudinal segment endpoints in Table 4; original landmark spans are in Table 1. Surface landmarks normally projected onto the segment axis.
primary_source.limitation: No individual length distribution or direct bone-on-stature regression; linear stature scaling is diagnostic only. Cross-cohort joint-offset assumptions remain distinct from ISB styloid-midpoint geometry.

source_access.full_text_storage: Inspected in scratch; linked/hashed, not redistributed.

figure_inspection: Original Table 4 visually checked; Tables 1/2 and main text reread.
essential_unavailable: Compatible radius/ulna endpoint offsets plus independent stature-conditioned geometry remain open.
